    cmin=min(j for i,j in shape); cmax=max(j for i,j in shape)
    mr,mj=shapecells[0]
    out=[[g[i][j] for j in range(len(g[0]))] for i in range(len(g))]
    dr,dc=mr-rmin,mj-cmax  # top-right of shape -> marker
    for i,j in shape: out[i+dr][j+dc]=markcol
    return out

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter

def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

for pn in ['1','2','3']:
    gi,go=f'Demo pair {pn} input',f'Demo pair {pn} output'
    g=G[gi]; cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells={(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x!=bg}
    vals=Counter(g[i][j] for i,j in cells)
    print('---',pn,'bg',bg,dict(vals))
    # shape = most common non-bg color; marker = other
    shapecol,_=vals.most_common(1)[0]
    marks=[(i,j,v) for i,j,v in [(i,j,g[i][j]) for i,j in cells] if v!=shapecol]
    print('marker cells:',marks)

import os,glob,re
def load():

        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
from itertools import product as dp
def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); bg=g[0][0]
    cnt=Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    order=[c_ for c_,n in cnt.most_common() if c_!=bg]
    mv=order[0]; mk=order[-1]
    T=mask_of(g,mv,bg); M=mask_of(g,mk,bg)
    d=(M[1][0]-M[0][0],M[1][1]-M[0][1])
    gp,gn=d[0],d[1]
    # perpendicular dirs: (gn,-gp) and (-gn,gp)
    dirs=((gn,-gp),(-gn,gp))
    templist=[(r,c) for r,c in T]
    def copy_shift(cells,sh):
        return {(r+sh[0],c+sh[1]) for r,c in cells}
    got=[[bg]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for r,c in T: got[r][c]=mv
    for r,c in M: got[r][c]=mk
    for gd,gnd in dirs:
        k=0
        while True:
            sh=(gd*k,gnd*k)
            cs={copy_shift(T,sh)}
            if not (cs & {(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W)}): break
            for r,c in sorted(cs & {(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W)}):
                got[r][c]=mk
            k+=1
    return got

def analyze_pair(i):
    g=G[f'Demo pair {i} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {i} output']
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); bg=g[0][0]
    cnt=Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    order=[c_ for c_,n in cnt.most_common() if c_!=bg]
    mv=order[0]; mk=order[-1]
    T=mask_of(g,mv,bg); M=mask_of(g,mk,bg)
    ms=min(M); mb=max(M)
    d=(mb[0]-ms[0],mb[1]-ms[1])
    gg=math.gcd(abs(d[0]),abs(d[1])) or 1
    u=(d[0]//gg,d[1]//gg)   # unit marker direction (may be diag or axis-aligned)
    perp=(-u[1],u[0])
    print(f'pair{i}: bg={bg} template color={mv}({len(T)}) marker={mk} markers={sorted(M)} dir={u} perp={perp}')
analyze_pair(5); analyze_pair(6); analyze_pair(7); analyze_pair(8)

    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); bg=g[0][0]

    mv=order[0]; mk=order[-1]
    T=mask_of(g,mv,bg); M=sorted(mask_of(g,mk,bg))
    got=[[bg]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for r,c in T: got[r][c]=mv
    for r,c in M: got[r][c]=mk
    mc=(sum(p[0] for p in M)/2,sum(p[1] for p in M)/2); tc=sum(p for p in T)/len(T)
    d=(M[1][0]-M[0][0],M[1][1]-M[0][1])
    gg=math.gcd(abs(d[0]),abs(d[1])) or 1
